method: Manual visual review of the original chapter JPEGs and their SAM-TS-L mask overlays for the 25 pages with nonempty SAM masks and zero small-INT8 RT-DETR text boxes. Pages were viewed in contact sheets and individually for unclear cases. Locations are approximate visual descriptions, not coordinates.

scope.selection: SAM positive pixels > 0 and RT-DETR text_box_count == 0; some pages still have RT bubble boxes

summary.dialogue_title_caption_observed: No clear ordinary dialogue, title, or caption was identified in this selected-page review; apparent visible text is predominantly stylized SFX.

limitations: Subjective visual audit only; no text polygons, pixel ground truth, precision/recall, or cleanability judgment.
A SAM mask overlapping visible lettering does not establish that the mask contains only lettering or is safe to inpaint.
Small/ambiguous marks need crop-level review; this chapter cannot establish COO transfer to other Korean webtoons.
